statement: RunPod lists on-demand H100 SXM rental at $3.49 per GPU-hour on Secure Cloud and $2.69 per GPU-hour on Community Cloud.
why: Published on-demand rental rates for the prior-generation workhorse GPU are a display-level reference for what spare capacity costs on the open market.

impact.mechanism: Listed hourly rental rates are a static price level for rented accelerator capacity; with no stated baseline or change on the page, no directional demand or supply read is taken.

confidence.basis: Provider's own live pricing page read directly, but it is one provider and carries no publication date or history.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 6.79 -> 3.49 (tol 1%); sources: runpod.io
